row: Shaw TV’s focus is on the support of Community Access programming that is produced by members of our local community, and the training of local community Volunteers in television production. Shaw TV also produces feature-length coverage of many special events in our local communities as part of our Community Access commitment, including festivals, forums, parades and amateur sports events.
